description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maththumagala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512011 (24/12006)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title settlement, cadastral maps, and determination of land ownership in specific districts. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title claims without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The document is explicitly labeled "PART III - LANDS" and contains multiple notices for different land parcels in the Gampaha District.
